summary.text: Tally is a document-style online form builder for creating, sharing, and embedding forms without coding.

context.text: Tally offers unlimited forms and submissions on its free plan, subject to fair usage guidelines. Pro and Business plans add features.
Visitors can try the builder without an account, but Tally’s terms say an account is required to publish a form.

links.label: Get started
links.description: Introductory help for creating and managing a form.

links.label: Create a form
links.description: Build with questions and blocks, then publish and share.

links.label: Form templates
links.description: Browse ready-made forms to adapt to your needs.

links.label: Use and create templates
links.description: Customize gallery templates or save forms as reusable templates.

links.label: Tally AI
links.description: Tally’s guide to generating and editing forms from prompts in the editor.

links.label: Import a form
links.description: Bring in Typeform forms or create editable drafts from uploaded files.

links.label: Feature overview
links.description: Entry point for Tally’s blocks, settings, integrations, and other features.

links.label: Input blocks
links.description: Choose fields for text, selections, dates, uploads, payments, and more.

links.label: Conditional logic
links.description: Show or hide blocks, skip pages, and route respondents based on answers.

links.label: Calculated fields
links.description: Calculate scores, prices, or other values from responses.

links.label: Hidden fields
links.description: Pass URL parameters into forms for personalization or traffic-source data.

links.label: Multi-page forms
links.description: Arrange questions across pages or show one question per page.

links.label: Form settings
links.description: Configure access, notifications, completion behavior, and other settings; some options require paid plans.

links.label: Customize a form
links.description: Adjust themes, colors, fonts, images, and layout; custom CSS requires Pro.

links.label: Embed a form
links.description: Add a standard, popup, or full-page form embed to a website.

links.label: Thank You pages
links.description: Customize the screen shown after submission, including different pages for different form paths.

links.label: File uploads
links.description: Collect respondent files; the free plan has a 10 MB per-file limit.

links.label: Payment forms
links.description: Collect card payments through Stripe; standard Stripe fees apply.

links.label: Electronic signatures
links.description: Add a signature field and export signed submissions as PDFs; check local legal requirements.

links.label: Pricing and plans
links.description: Compare the free plan with Pro and Business features and fair-use limits.

links.label: Help center
links.description: Browse Tally’s guides on building forms, integrations, and billing.

links.label: Privacy notice
links.description: Read how Tally says it processes personal data and handles data requests.

links.label: Terms and conditions
links.description: Review account, usage, subscription, and support terms.
